concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-reports-and-fees-balance-platform-accounting-report]] — 2026-09-15 capture of the daily/interactive Balance Platform Accounting Report field and event reference for liable/user balance changes, pending-versus-booked IDs, CET booking window, value dates and signed register examples; bank-transfer rows are not independent bank-receipt proof.
warnings: The source's top-up example has `received` rows without Transaction Id but nonzero Reserved/Balance register movements; do not derive an invariant from that example against the general ID rule.
The source describes the report as helping confirm payouts, while its bank/booked mapping is balance-account movement and does not independently prove beneficiary bank receipt.
